cases.disease: Hepatocellular carcinoma (germline MCC insertion proposed to contribute to tumorigenesis)
cases.mechanism_detail: Germline 5.3-kb L1-Ta in MCC, heterozygous in donor 70 and homozygous in donor 95; MCC mRNA and protein strongly reduced in tumour (and in nontumour liver for donor 95) with CTNNB1 upregulation. Causality for HCC is inferred, not proven.
cases.quote: Four out of 19 individuals studied here, including two cases each of HBV and HCV infection, presented distinct germline L1 or Alu insertions contributing to MCC suppression in tumor and nontumor liver tissue.
